title: Rethinking Druggability in the Evaluation of AI-driven Structure-based Drug Design

contributions.purpose: 指出 AI 驱动 SBDD 评测普遍忽略靶点可成药性(druggability)
contributions.mechanism: 综述 CrossDocked2020 等基准与 druggability 评估方法(经验/配体/结构/序列/AI 类),剖析仅用 docking 分评测的缺陷
contributions.evaluation: 定性论证(无实验):生成模型可靠在不可成药口袋生成大而疏水分子刷高 docking 分,若基准含本质不可成药口袋则高分无意义;约 2 万人类蛋白仅数千可成药
contributions.domain: AI 结构药物设计(SBDD)评测
contributions.source_quote: many current AI evaluation benchmarks ignore druggability and treat every pocket as equally suitable for drug discovery.

contributions.purpose: 提出把连续 druggability 分数纳入 SBDD 评测的方法
contributions.mechanism: 用 PockDrug/DrugPred 等预测器给每个口袋算连续可成药分 s_i,构造 druggability 加权 docking 分 score=Σs_i·D̄_i/Σs_i,并按阈值(0.2/0.5/0.8)切分 CrossDocked2020 为高/低可成药子集做分层分析
contributions.evaluation: 定性方法学提议(无实证验证);s_i>0.5 子集代表现实靶点,低可成药子集作负对照;建议对预测器用已知药物-靶点对做校准
contributions.source_quote: we propose a druggability-weighted docking score: score_weighted = (sum_i s_i D_i) / (sum_i s_i), where D_i is the mean docking score of all generated ligands for pocket i.

self_declared_provenance.quote: we propose augmenting existing datasets like CrossDocked2020 [9] with continuous druggability scores and weighting generative performance accordingly.
